fields.subject: Connection Configuration Hierarchy
fields.trigger: a provider's Databases collection is constructed from its bound options type, which implements IDatabaseConfigurationOptions
fields.response: take the configured databases solely from DbConnectionsInternal: when that view (or the options value) is null, log a warning that the database configuration section may be missing and produce an empty collection; when any entry is null, throw; otherwise attach the global configuration and the entry itself (as the database level) to each entry's read and write endpoints and key the entry by its DatabaseKey
fields.postcondition: every provider presents its database configuration to the provider-neutral core through one read-only interface, and each endpoint of a configured database resolves its settings through the global and database levels of the hierarchy
